title: Delete Nodes From Linked List Present in Array
summary: Given an array of integers and a linked list, remove all nodes from the linked list whose values are present in the array, then return the modified linked list head.
statement: Given an array of integers and a linked list, remove all nodes from the linked list whose values are present in the array, then return the modified linked list head.
constraints: nums is nonempty and head is a nonempty singly linked list.
Remove every node whose value occurs in nums while preserving the order of surviving nodes.
Return the first surviving node, or None if every node is removed.
hints: A dummy predecessor handles deletions at the head with the same splice used elsewhere.
Store forbidden values in a set and examine current.next before advancing.
If next is blocked, bypass it; otherwise move current forward; return dummy.next.
Each original node is visited once, every blocked node is bypassed, and surviving links retain their original relative order.
editorial: Each original node is visited once, every blocked node is bypassed, and surviving links retain their original relative order.
